text:
toni: FYI I'm planning a small publish this evening: Py/TS SDKs v3.0.1. This fixes packaging header order and removes a legacy shim we promised to deprecate. Quiet window 02:30 UTC. Canaries for 10% traffic for 1h then 50%.

nate: What's the shim removal surface? Any runtime break for users who imported from the old path?

toni: We removed `redwood.sdk.legacy` alias; recommended import is `redwood.sdk`. We added an import shim in 3.0.0 but it's noisy; 3.0.1 removes it. Most users should be fine, but anyone directly importing legacy path will break. We'll add a deprecation blurb in the release notes.

leah: We should set a dist-tag for signed artifacts so we don't accidentally switch consumers that rely on registry signature semantics. Proposal: create `signed-latest` dist-tag pointing to v3.0.0 (current signed release) and make `latest` point to v3.0.1-canary during canary. If rollback needed, revert `latest` -> `signed-latest`.

deploy-bot: @channel starting publish: ref refs/heads/main -> tag v3.0.1-canary at 2026-03-22T02:30:00Z. Canary cohort 10%. Logs: https://internal/release/5112

ci-bot: Preflight: wheel and tarball checks passed. Integration smoke (basic auth + embed flow) queued.

toni: If we see import errors in nightly smoke, we hold. Rollback criteria: any of these during first 2h: >5% failed SDK integration tests, >=3 bug reports about import errors, registry rejects for signature, or publish-bot error rate >0.5%.

ops-oncall: I'll watch registry ingestion alerts and the publish-bot dashboard. If you want auto-revert, we can enable `deploybot.auto_revert_on_integration_failure`. Recommend on for this one.

nate: Agree. Also let's add a short note to CHANGELOG: mention removal, how to migrate, and dist-tag guidance. I'll draft it.

leah: For pinned consumers: recommend pinning to `signed-latest` or exact semver. I'll update docs. Add a small snippet for CI teams:

```
# pin to signed-latest for safety
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@v3.0.0 signed-latest
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@v3.0.1-canary latest
# to pin in CI
npm i @redwood/sdk@signed-latest
pip install redwood-sdk==3.0.0
```

deploy-bot: publish step 2/3: artifacts uploaded to staging. No immediate errors.

ci-bot: Nightly smoke (includes explicit import path test) started against tag v3.0.1-canary (sha: b7a9f2d).

toni: Leaving the `auto_revert_on_integration_failure` flag ON. If the nightly smoke shows import failures, deploy-bot will automatically move `latest` back to `signed-latest` and post here.

ci-bot: Nightly smoke completed: 98 failures out of 250 tests — majority are import path failures in legacy import tests. Failing test names: test_legacy_imports, test_shim_deprecation_notice. Details: https://ci/internal/5112/failures

ops-oncall: Noted. Triggering hold and auto-revert.

deploy-bot: Auto-revert engaged: moving npm dist-tag `latest` -> `signed-latest` (v3.0.0). Re-publishing Py wheel for v3.0.0 to ensure `latest` points to signed artifact.

leah: Thanks. Can we also publish a quick advisory in #release-notes and update the CHANGELOG with migration steps + apology?

toni: I'm on it. Adding migration snippet and a link to the pinned `signed-latest` guidance. Also will open a small PR to reintroduce a compatibility shim for one minor cycle (3.0.x -> 3.1.0) to give customers time.

nate: I'll coordinate a small support broadcast to customers who upgraded in the last 30 days. We should include how to pin and the timeline for permanent removal.

deploy-bot: Auto-revert complete. `latest` now points to v3.0.0 (signed). Canary tag v3.0.1-canary remains for investigation.

toni: Post-mortem action items: 1) stronger canary smoke to include legacy import tests before promoting, 2) dist-tag docs update, 3) add registry signature checks to preflight, 4) communicate timeline and offer shim backport. I'll create the follow-up issue.

leah: I'll update docs and changelog. Nate will handle customer comms. Ops will monitor for any stray installs to `latest`.

ops-oncall: Will watch pypi/npm download spikes for v3.0.1-canary and handle any automated installs. Will post any anomalies here.

toni: Thanks all. Lesson learned: packaging + removal of shim needs explicit legacy import test in preflight. Will share the issue once created. :pray:
